posts.title: Emmanuel Kateregga Wins Monthly Grand Knockout, Claims UGX 250,000 Prize
posts.excerpt: In a dramatic final at Kabalagala, Emmanuel K. defeated David Musoke 3-1 in the best-of-five final to claim the March Monthly Grand Knockout title and top prize. The match drew the largest crowd in CuePointe history, with over 80 spectators gathered at the venue.
